publisher.statement: North is 148.4 degrees left of vertical

proof: For the implemented east-left WCS, celestial north projects to raster direction (-sin(rotation)/abs(scaleX), -cos(rotation)/scaleY). Thus positive rotation is north-left of vertical. Slight angular deviation below arises from publisher rounded anisotropic 9.3×5.5-degree footprint.
limitations: Only the sign of the publisher orientation conversion is corrected.
The webpage centre and footprint remain approximate; absent embedded reference pixel and exact scale are not recovered.
No optical-star registration or physical reconstruction acceptance. Four independently qualified candidate gates remain unchanged.

visualCheck.result: Corrected bright bar, northern dust knot and southwestern tail agree with the Herschel morphology in the common sky plane. This checks gross placement only, not measured astrometric residuals.
